registry.title: InovaRegistry
registry.subtitle: Industry solutions and university projects we find on visits, at AI summits, at events and on the web, in one searchable place.

cards.title: Business cards
cards.formHelp: Add a photo of each card you collected. Photos are shrunk on your device to a few dozen KB before upload and stay readable.
cards.addHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP. You can pick several at once.
cards.name: Name on card
cards.badFile: Couldn't read {{name}}. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
cards.tooMany: A record can hold up to {{max}} business cards.
cards.uploadFailed_one: {{count}} business card couldn't be saved. Open the record and try again.
cards.uploadFailed_other: {{count}} business cards couldn't be saved. Open the record and try again.

registry.search: Search by project, university, company, creator or tech stack…
registry.emptyBody: Log the first industry solution or university project you came across.
registry.noMatchBody: Try a shorter search or clear the filters.

detail.creator: Creator
detail.deleteBody: {{code}} will be removed from InovaRegistry for everyone.

form.title: Log a new solution
form.description: Record an industry solution or university project you found. Fields marked * are required.
form.creator: Creator / author name
form.techStackHelp: Separate with commas, e.g. Python, PyTorch, React
form.summaryPh: What problem it solves and how, in two or three lines
form.moreHelp: Fill in what you know, for example from an expo list or the company's website.
form.taglinePh: One line on what they do
form.servicesPh: e.g. AI strategy, ERP integration, data platforms
form.projectsProductsPh: Named products, delivered projects, notable clients

ai.title: AI details
ai.formHelp: Fill these in when the solution uses AI, so AI projects can be tracked and compared. Leave them empty otherwise.
ai.tagsHelp: Every AI area it covers, separated by commas.
ai.tagsPh: e.g. AI Agents, GenAI/LLM, Computer Vision
ai.workPh: What the AI does, e.g. reads delivery notes and fills the invoice automatically
ai.uniquePointPh: What makes it different from other solutions
ai.intensityPick: How much of the solution is AI

intensityHelp.Low: AI helps with a small part of the work.
intensityHelp.Medium: AI does an important part of the work.
intensityHelp.High: AI is the core of the solution.
